scope: OBD-II standardized PID and DTC reference evidence

sources.name: OBD2 Data Pack v5 | CSS Electronics
sources.notes: Machine-readable evidence basis for the normalized Mode 01 inventory. Raw MF4 and proprietary manufacturer DBC material is intentionally not committed.

sources.role: Cross-reference for standard services, PID semantics, formulas, supported-PID bitmaps, and the distinction between standardized and manufacturer-defined PIDs.
Reference for Diagnostic Trouble Code families and human-facing code lookup. DTCs are deliberately not merged into the PID catalog.

boundaries: A PID being standardized or present in this quarry does not prove that a specific vehicle supports it.
Vehicle support must be discovered at runtime from ECU evidence, including supported-PID bitmaps where applicable.
Manufacturer-specific PIDs and proprietary CAN signals remain outside this standardized Mode 01 catalog.
DTCs are fault identifiers returned by diagnostic services; they are not live-data PIDs.
This quarry does not change AutoPulse runtime decoder behavior or certify new vehicle compatibility.
